text: うちの　ピカチュウの　ほうが　その　ばいは　かわいい　わい！

structure.jp: うちの　ピカチュウの　ほうが
structure.en: my Pikachu is the one that

structure.jp: その　ばいは　かわいい　わい！
structure.en: is at least twice as cute as that!

patterns.name: 〜のほうが
patterns.span: ピカチュウの　ほうが
patterns.explanation: のほうが after a thing picks it as the winner when two are compared. うちのピカチュウのほうがかわいい = 'my Pikachu is the cuter one'.

patterns.name: 〜は (at least)
patterns.explanation: は after an amount means 'at least that much'. そのばいは = 'at least twice that'.

patterns.name: 〜わい
patterns.explanation: わい at the end is an old-man way of pushing your point with feeling. かわいいわい = 'is cute, I tell you!'.
